inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: It was observed that there were eighteen children with one caregiver when arriving at the operation with a specific age group of two years old.    This was corrected when another caregiver arrived to the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was observed in the infant classroom there were two play yards that there were holes in the netting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: It was observed that one classroom had seven children present with children under 18 months who were more than 18 months in age difference.    This was corrected when the group of children were spilt into two groups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: It was observed that two children were resting or napping on non napping equipment in the classroom.  This was corrected at inspection when each of the children were provided with a nap mat or cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant based on information obtained.    It was discovered that a caregiver was not using positive methods to redirect children due to their behaviors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway: It was observed that the arrangement of children in the nap room did not allow for a walkway other than stepping over children and mats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: It was observed that three children were resting or napping on couch in the classroom.    This was corrected at inspection when each of the children were provided with a nap mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Recommend or impose an enforcement action: It was discovered that three of seven staff CPR/First Aid cards were falsified that were presented to licensing during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Recommend or impose an enforcement action (26 TAC §745.8605)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. A caregiver failed to supervise a group of children when the caregiver left 8 children, ages 19 months to 3 years old unsupervised in the classroom for approximately 2-3 minutes. In addition, during this time another caregiver was asked to supervise this class and instead remained in their own classroom which prevented this caregiver from having visual and auditory awareness of the ongoing activities in the classroom left unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during the investigation that the operation was notified children were left unattended and failed to report to Child Care Regulations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    Incident reports were not available for the incident of six children ages 3-8 years old were left unattended and one child exiting the building to the parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    Parents were not notified that their children were left unattended in the gym by staff and that a three old had exited the building and was in the parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered that a group of six children between the ages of 3-8 were left alone for about 1-2 minutes and were able to open a door leading to the parking lot. A three-year-old was able to exit and was stand a few feet from door in the parking lot while the others remained in the gym.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    The operation failed to report to licensing that children were left unattended in the gym.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    The director failed to ensure that staff were following minimum standards in her absence from the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    As part of an investigation it was discovered that a caregiver whose presence at the operation is on a  provisional basis and must never be left in charge of a group of children was working in a classroom alone with children and was in charge of a group of children.    This was corrected as the staff is no longer employed at operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: It was observed during the walkthrough there were several plugs missing plug covers assessible to children.    This was corrected at inspection when the director covered all the outlets missing plug covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was observed that two children had left a classroom without staff's knowledge and were discovered by a parent and licensing in the hallway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Illness Preventing Care - Symptoms of Possible Severe Illness: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    During the investigation it was discovered that the staff were not following their operational procedures.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Illness Preventing Care - Symptoms of Possible Severe Illness (26 TAC §746.3601(3)(E))

occurrences.finding: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during the investigation that two staff were vaping on the premises of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during the investigation that a staff/volunteer was present at the operation and interacting with children prior to a background check being ran.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: It was observed that there were three bottles in the refigerator that were not label with the child's name to whom they belonged to.    This was corrected when the caregiver labeled the bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Kept for 3 Months: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during the investigation that operation did not have medication records available for a child that counter medication had been administered to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Kept for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.3805(d))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    During the investigation it was discovered that infant daily reports shared with the parents did not have all components that are required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during the investigation that staff were using blankets in cribs for children under 12 months of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: During the follow up inspection the opertion had not obtained lacking  health statement or parent statement their child had been seen in past 12 months by doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection it was observed that there were six children with a specific age of 12 months old being cared for by one caregiver.    This was corrected when another caregiver came into the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: During follow up inspection the operation had not obtained the  lacking medical authorization for one of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: During follow up inspection operatio had not otained lacking employement  affidavit for the three staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During follow up iinspection there was one child under two years old that was watching a video on the tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During follow up inspection operation had not obtained  lacking complete address for their emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three of five children's files reviewed were lacking a health statement or parent statement their child had been seen in past 12 months by doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of five children's files reviewed was lacking their medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Three of four staff files reviewed were lacking their affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: It was observed that children under two years old were watching a tv in their classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three of five children's files reviewed were lacking complete address for their emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: During follow up in two seperate classrooms there were staff with conditions that were left alone with a group of children.    This was corrected when another staff without conditions came in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: During follow up inspection it was observed that a staff wiith background conditions was not following their conditions when I arrived at operation.    This was corrected when another staff without conditions came in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: As part of an investigation it was discovered that a caregiver whose presence at the operation is on a provisional basis and must never be left in charge of a group of children was working in a classroom alone with children and was in charge of a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: It was observed during the inspection that children were being cared for in non licensed room. It was also, observed that the operation had added space to their infant room without notifying licensing prior.    This was corrected when the children were moved to a licesensed classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: It was observed that on a shelf under the changing table there were a multiple cleaning supplies and hand sanitizer accessible to children. (photos taken)    This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed cleaning supplies and place out of reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver whose presence at the operation is on a provisional basis and must never be left in charge of a group of children was observed working in a classroom alone with and in charge of a group of children.     This was corrected at inspection as another staff member went into the classroom with the staff member.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: An initial fire inspecton was not available at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: An initial sanitation inspection was not available at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: It was observed that the operational policies was lacking multiple required policies.    A list was left with permit holder of missing policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
